name: blok_read
description: Read the document as a tree of blocks with ids, types and text. Read before you edit, and again after a STALE error.

oneOf.description: A block id, or "$ref" of a block an earlier command created.

items.description: A block id, or "$ref" of a block an earlier command created.

name: blok_describe
description: Look up what you can do. With no arguments it lists tools and commands. Pass { tool } or { command } to get the argument schema.

name: blok_execute
description: Run a batch of commands. Either all of them land or none do. Use block ids from blok_read. Call blok_describe for a command's arguments.
